query: How will we define core versus adaptable components, with objective fidelity thresholds and an adaptation classification protocol (minor vs major)?

response.query: How will we define core versus adaptable components, with objective fidelity thresholds and an adaptation classification protocol (minor vs major)?
response.answer: Core components are essential, unchanged by adaptations; adaptable components can undergo minor or major changes. Minor adaptations maintain core functionality; major adaptations alter core functionality. Fidelity thresholds define acceptable deviations for minor adaptations.
